title: aw-anarchy-2008-heavyweight
label: Kaige

won.source: Its champions page: 'EWA Heavyweight Championship: Kaige - Victory Vs. Scorpio Vs. Haystack - 10.28.2K7'; its Vault lists 'Kaige defeats Scorpio and Haystack MacMillon' at HalloWicked 2K7.

how: Won the three-way at HalloWicked 2K7 and defended against Gigantor on 2 December 2007 (RIOT! 2K7); the owner vacated the title on 13 December 2007.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-heavyweight
label: Morrigan

won.source: Its champions page: 'Morrigan - Victory vs Vinny Vegas - 07.29.2k8'; the All Nite Action 1 main event ends: 'NEW...HEAVYWEIGHT CHAMPION.....The Clockwork Soldier...BEN...MORRRIIIGGANNNNN!'

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Jason Lovell - Victory vs Morrigan - 09.21.2k8'.

how: Won the steel-cell main event of All Nite Action 1 from Vinny Vegas by technical knockout; the fed calls him the first champion since Kaige.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-heavyweight
label: Jason Lovell

won.source: Its champions page: 'Jason Lovell - Victory vs Morrigan - 09.21.2k8'.

how: Won the title at Cold Fall; the 2010 page lists the title vacant on 1 January 2010.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-heavyweight
label: Dave Wilson

won.source: Its 2010 champions page: 'Dave Wilson: -Victory against Rabbithole finalists- Spaz | Mesterio Raine | Erik Dafoe | Rocky G - 03.14.10'; the Idus Martias review ends with Vic Powers handing him the belt.

how: Won the Rabbithole finals of Idus Martias with Vic Powers's help. The All Nite Action IX card bills him as champion against Spaz in a cage match in which 'if Wilson has any interference he will forfeit the title'; the review has Spaz pin him, and no page says what became of the belt.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-north-american
label: Morrigan (EWA)

won.source: Its champions page: 'North American Championship: Morrigan - Victory Vs. Bazza Vs. Kain - 10.28.2K7'.

how: Won the three-way at HalloWicked 2K7 and defended against Vayne (12 November), Volta (18 November) and the Apokalypto match (2 December 2007); the record lists no loss before the fed's collapse in January 2008.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-north-american
label: Morrigan (AW)

won.source: Its champions page: 'Awarded - Morrigan - 04.07.2k8'.

how: Awarded the belt on 7 April 2008 and beaten by Morgan Call in Blunt Trauma's three-way.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-north-american
label: Morgan Call

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - Morgan Call - 04.20.2k8'; the Blunt Trauma main event ends with her declared the new North American champion.

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Vacated - 07.29.2k8'; at All Nite Action 1 the owner says she and Judith Orestes are missing in action and released, and the title is vacant.

how: Won the three-way at Blunt Trauma from Morrigan and Jeff Jackson; vacated when she and a rival were released.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-north-american
label: Devlin Raine

won.source: Its 2010 champions page: 'Won - Devlin Raine - North American Scramble Match - 01.17.10'.

how: Won the scramble match of 17 January 2010 (Noitcerusser II) and defended against Mark Cannon at Idus Martias on 14 March 2010 by technical knockout.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-iron-man
label: James Caine

won.source: Its champions page: 'Tier V - Iron Man championship: James Caine - Victory Vs. Scorpio - 11.12.2K7'; its Vault lists 'James Caine defeats Scorpio' on the 12 November Knockout.

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Madison Divera - Victory Vs. James Caine - 11.18.2K7'.

how: Won from Scorpio in November 2007.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-iron-man
label: Madison Divera

won.source: Its champions page: 'Madison Divera - Victory Vs. James Caine - 11.18.2K7'; its Vault lists 'Madison Divera defeats James Caine'.

how: Won from James Caine on 18 November 2007 and defended against him at RIOT! 2K7 on 2 December; the record does not say how the belt left her before 13 December 2007.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-iron-man
label: Spaz Blud

won.source: Its champions page: 'Spaz Blud - Victory vs James Caine - 13.12.2K7'; its Vault lists 'Spaz Defeats James Caine' at Knockout V.

how: Won from James Caine at Knockout V; the record does not say how Caine came to hold the belt after Madison Divera's defence of 2 December.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-iron-man
label: Suriel N. Crowlie

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - Suriel N. Crowlie - 7.13.2k8'; the Noitcerusser I review ends 'NEW...IRON MAN CHAMPION....SURIEL...N...CROWLIE!'

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Won - The Diablo Slayer - 8.12.2k8'.

how: Won from Morgan Call at Noitcerusser I and lost it to The Diablo Slayer in the last minutes of All Nite Action 2.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-iron-man
label: The Diablo Slayer

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - The Diablo Slayer - 8.12.2k8'; the All Nite Action 2 rundown ends 'We have a new Iron Man Champion!'

how: Won the belt by pinning Suriel N. Crowlie after attacking Jon Tees, Matt Ward and Crowlie with a wrench; the belt was combined into the Untamed Championship on 21 September 2008.

end.source: Its champions page: 'Combined to new title - 9.21.2k8'.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-chaos-theory
label: Matt Ward and Suriel N. Crowlie

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - Matt Ward & Suriel Night Crowlie - 8.12.2k8'; in All Nite Action 2's main event Jon Tees hands each of them a belt.

lost.source: The All Nite Action V card says Vinny Vegas and Maxx Kalifornia 'became Chaos Theory champions together at Cold Fall' (21 September 2008); the champions page captured on 27 September still lists Ward and Crowlie.

how: Won as Jon Tees's setup in All Nite Action 2's main event.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-chaos-theory
label: Vinny Vegas and Maxx Kalifornia

won.source: The All Nite Action V card: 'Vinny Vegas and Maxx Kalifornia became Chaos Theory champions together at Cold Fall'; Cold Fall is dated 21 September 2008 on the fed's calendar.

how: Won in the World War Chaos Theory match at Cold Fall; no page records how the reign ended.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-chaos-theory
label: Scott Owens and Ben Morrigan

won.source: Its 2010 champions page: 'Scott Owens & Ben Morrigan - Victory over Parental Advisory - 03.14.10'; the Idus Martias review has Morrigan hand them both belts.

how: Won the thumbtacks, ladders and wire match at Idus Martias, Morrigan replacing the absent Ryan Payne; the All Nite Action IX card bills both as champions.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-untamed
label: The Diablo Slayer

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - The Diablo Slayer - 9.21.2k8'.

how: The first Untamed champion, from the Cold Fall combination of the No Limit and Iron Man belts; the record lists no end before the award of 1 January 2010.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-untamed
label: The Diablo Slayer (2010)

won.source: Its 2010 champions page: 'Awarded - TDS - 01.01.10'.

how: Awarded the belt again on 1 January 2010 and bound to defend it at every Action; he beat Jesse Williams for it at All Nite Action IX.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-no-limit
label: Breeze

won.source: Its champions page: 'Won - Breeze - 8.26.2k8'; its Vault: 'Breeze (1st No Limit Champion...)' on All Nite Action 3.

how: The first and only champion; the belt was combined on 21 September 2008.

end.source: Its champions page: 'Combined to New Title - 9.21.2k8'.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-ewa-tag-team
label: Devestation Inc.

won.source: Its champions page: 'Devestation Inc. - Victory Vs. Vic Powers & James Caine - 10.28.2K7'; its Vault lists the same pairing at HalloWicked 2K7.

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Dog House - Victory Vs. Devestation Inc. - 11.12.2K7'.

how: Won at HalloWicked 2K7 against Vic Powers and James Caine.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-ewa-tag-team
label: Dog House

won.source: Its champions page: 'Dog House - Victory Vs. Devestation Inc. - 11.12.2K7'; its Vault: 'Iceman and Mad Dog defeat Anthony Dunnucci and Joey Stilletti'.

lost.source: Its champions page: 'Beauty & the Beast - Victory vs Dog House - 12.13.2K7'.

how: Won from Devestation Inc. and defended against Damage Co. on 2 December 2007.

title: aw-anarchy-2008-ewa-tag-team
label: Beauty & the Beast

won.source: Its champions page: 'Beauty & the Beast - Victory vs Dog House - 12.13.2K7'; its Vault lists 'Madison Divera and Die Hard defeat Iceman and Mad Dog' at Knockout V.

how: The last champions listed before the fed's collapse in January 2008.
